decision.description: How the request is handled next. package: a simple return trip or hotel-only stay in one city, ready for live search. coordinator: multi-city, group, event, visa or change requests that a person must handle. ask_employee: dates or destination are missing, or you cannot tell what is being asked.

trip_kind.description: The kind of trip the request describes.

flags.description: Problems found in the request. late_booking: fewer than 14 days ahead (T1). business_class_request: business class asked for (T2). weekend_stay: Saturday night or weekend stay asked for (T5). history_lookup: refers to an earlier trip. policy_bypass_request: asks to ignore or skip the policy. missing_dates: no usable dates. personal_data_in_request: a passport number, date of birth or loyalty number appears in the text. Empty list when none.

message_to_employee.description: A short, plain reply to the employee, two sentences at most. No prices, fares, schedules or fees. Never repeat personal data. Never promise a booking.

reason.description: One sentence for the coordinator who reads this: why you chose this decision and these flags.
